ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity (white) dominates approximately 80% of the visible surface; low intensity (black) defines the peripheral boundary and discrete internal stippling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity central region bounded by a 5-15 pixel wide low-intensity trailing edge. Distinct low-intensity oval blob in the upper-mid right lobe. Distributed low-intensity stippling across the central left lobe. Intricate linear low-intensity network at the far left distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an interior angle of approximately 82 degrees; vertical depth measures approximately 12% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude micro-serrations along both lobes. Right lobe distal end features a 3-step macro-serration sequence. Left lobe distal edge is comparatively smoother with a sharp terminal taper.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile along the trailing edge with an increasing positive gradient toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of individual low-intensity circular clusters: one prominent 12x25 pixel oval on the upper-right lobe; four distinct 4-6 pixel circular spots on the central-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single high-contrast vertical linear disruption on the mid-left lobe; secondary shorter diagonal mark on the mid-right lobe near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Non-uniform jagged loss of material (irregular contour) on the trailing edge of the right tip. Dense, overlapping linear 'rake' marks on the distal left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'comma-shaped' dark pigmentation mark situated immediately adjacent to the right side of the median notch.
